# EvPopover

> A popover is a small floating panel anchored to a trigger, used to surface contextual content — a short form, details, or controls — on click, without navigating away from the current view.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `evoq-ui:popover` |
| Layer | Molecule (`src/molecules`) |
| Import | `import { EvPopover } from 'evoq-ui'` |
| Template tag | `<EvPopover>` or `<ev-popover>` |
| Source | `src/molecules/popover/EvPopover.vue` |
| Extra attributes go to | the root `<span class="ev-popover">` |

## Example

```vue
<EvPopover
  title="Ubah nama"
  description="Nama tampil di seluruh laporan."
>
  Taruh formulir singkat di sini.
</EvPopover>
```

## Design guidance

From the Figma page **Popover**, frame `4419:83485` (Popover). These rules are binding. Names in them are Figma's - the Vue API is the tables above.

### When to use

- Use to present focused, interactive content next to a trigger — a quick edit form, filters, or extra details — that the user acts on and dismisses without leaving the page.

### When not to use

- Don't use for plain text hints — use a Tooltip (`evoq-ui:tooltip`). Don't use for blocking, decision-critical flows — use a Modal (`evoq-ui:modal`). Don't pack a long, scrolling form into a popover.

### Do

- Keep the content short and self-contained. Anchor the popover to its trigger and dismiss it on outside click or Esc. Give a clear title when the content needs context.

### Don't

- Don't stack popovers or open one from inside another. Don't rely on it for content the user must not miss — it dismisses easily and isn't available on touch hover.

## Contract

- Only the props, slots and events above exist on `EvPopover`; anything not listed is not part of its API.
- An attribute that is not a prop (`class`, `id`, `aria-*`, `data-*`) goes to the root `<span class="ev-popover">`.
- Import it by name from `evoq-ui`; styles come once from `evoq-ui/style.css`.
- Refer to it by id `evoq-ui:popover` - the id stays the same if the component moves layer.
